The illuminated offerings flank a framed crescent and glass votive. The blue and pearl Information palette and gold-green Ascension canopy remain distinct at 64 px. The serialized LOD chain passed at 794/482/177 triangles.

The brick and concrete arcade remains identifiable around the blue central votive in both previews. The small candles are separated along the threshold and the canopy bears on the arch. The serialized LOD chain passed at 794/482/177 triangles.

The rooted fork, supported crescent and two amber chimes make a clear silhouette even in the Dawn thumbnail. The small offering dish faces the approach on its own stone step in all three ages. The serialized LOD chain passed at 570/386/178 triangles.

models.observations: The dark Medieval lancets show intact lower borders, and the Renaissance rose and door seat cleanly against the rounded narthex. Both twin-tower silhouettes read at 64 pixels. The serialized LOD chain passed at 1286/680/277 triangles.

The brick and Modern towers now carry complete pointed windows. The entrance collar, circular rose and blue panes remain legible against the darker Industrial facade. The door jambs and rose reveal follow the narthex face at each LOD. The serialized LOD chain passed at 1286/680/277 triangles.

A single blue glass leaf now sits visibly on a continuous stem above the green or gold roof. The rose and door have solid mounts into the narthex and the narrower windows maintain their sill line on both ages' pale towers. The serialized LOD chain passed at 1342/714/299 triangles.

The cloister tower window reads as a fully surrounded pointed pane in all three age previews. The corrected angle follows the narrowing bell tower. The pool, crescent and open arch remain distinct in the court. The serialized LOD chain passed at 924/597/256 triangles.

Both brick and concrete cloisters retain the courtyard gate and round pool. The blue tower lancet has an unbroken frame from its sill to the arch peak. The serialized LOD chain passed at 924/597/256 triangles.

The silver jamb stands clear against the glazed campanile in Information and Ascension. The apron of the conical window reveal follows the glass wall and the open court reads at 64 pixels. The serialized LOD chain passed at 924/597/256 triangles.

The two Iron treads now show their upper surfaces in front of the stone base. Both lead to the moon gate, and the wood ribs and small offering bowls still read separately at full size. The serialized LOD chain passed at 1112/670/219 triangles.

Two grounded steps are visible along the entrance axis in all three ages. The dark Medieval timber tread, pale Classical approach and warm Renaissance stone each progress clearly up to the crescent arch. The serialized LOD chain passed at 1112/670/219 triangles.

The paired glass blades visibly extend the outline on supported stems. Both Information and Ascension retain a clear front approach, with the two treads distinct from the plinth. The serialized LOD chain passed at 1224/738/263 triangles.

The blue blades have complete exposed profiles beside the brick or concrete roof, and their branching supports return to the wall. Both previews show two projected treads meeting the entrance platform. The serialized LOD chain passed at 1224/738/263 triangles.

At 64 pixels the broad pedestal reads as earth brown in Dawn, ochre in Bronze and slate grey in Iron. Its exposed top and front rim carry the change. The forked olive trunk still leads the eye to the open crescent in each age. In renders of the exported LOD0, LOD1 and LOD2, the pedestal becomes more angular and the offering dish simplifies to a gold spot, while the crescent and branch silhouette stay clear. The package validator passed at 570/386/178 triangles.
